## What changed

- Recording an acknowledgement with `kmctl summary ack` now writes one file per acknowledgement, so branches merge without conflicts (#62)
- `kmctl check` now fails when two decision records share the same number (#63)

## Other changes

None.

## Install

```sh
uv tool install git+https://github.com/JasperHG90/kmctl@v0.15.0#subdirectory=packages/kmctl
```

In a workflow:

```yaml
- uses: JasperHG90/kmctl@v0.15.0
```

**Full diff**: https://github.com/JasperHG90/kmctl/compare/v0.14.0...v0.15.0
